notes.title: Accessing Legacy Versions
notes.content: This version of the [b][i]King's Quest Collection[/i][/b] has been optimized to support additional Operating Systems. Existing game installations will not be modified but shortcuts will default to the 2016 Collection. The other version can be accessed by right-clicking the game in your Steam Library and selecting [i]Play King's Quest Collection Legacy[i].
